COOKIES & STORAGE

What this website uses
in your browser.

A factual description of cookies and storage based on the current generated site and documented hosting model.

Plan your projectExplore services

SITE-CONTROLLED STORAGE

What our pages do.

The HeyDock HTML, CSS and JavaScript in this repository do not set advertising or analytics cookies and do not write enquiry fields to localStorage or sessionStorage.

Catalogue filters on the software page operate in the current page document only. Custom select disclosures are progressive enhancements around native form controls.

HOSTING AND NETWORK

What may still occur.

Cloudflare Pages (the intended production host) may set or rely on cookies or similar technologies that are strictly necessary for security, load balancing or platform operation. Those behaviours are controlled by Cloudflare and should be re-checked on the live production hostname after deployment.

Private preview or sign-in gateways used during development are separate from the public Pages deployment and may use their own authentication cookies. They are not part of the intended public visitor experience.

CHANGES

If we add optional cookies later.

If analytics or non-essential cookies are introduced later, this page and any required consent mechanism must be updated before those technologies are enabled. This task does not add an analytics product or cookie banner.
